svg.title: Confluence connector code map
svg.desc: The Confluence connector's main classes and who calls whom. The command line stores or clears the personal access token, shows status, or starts the MCP server after configuring logging. The MCP server's twenty-nine tools call account-bound services that AppContext in bootstrap.py builds and rebuilds when the stored username changes. The services validate input and call ConfluenceApi and PageLinkResolver, which send every request through ConfluenceTransport; the transport reads the token from TokenStore through the CredentialSource port. Hover an item for details.
svg.text: Main classes and who calls whom · arrows point to the callee · hover an item for details
__main__.py · main() parses the command, then runs its branch

g.title: Prompts for a personal access token without echo, verifies it with the current-user endpoint, stores it with the returned username, then writes a measured cql_timezone if none is set. --sign-out deletes the local token; it does not revoke it in Confluence. → AppContext.verify_token, TokenStore.save / sign_out, AppContext.calibrate_cql_timezone

Offline stored-account status; --check verifies the stored token, then compares the configured cql_timezone with a fresh measurement, or writes it when unset. → AppContext.auth_status / check_auth_status
Configures the per-process log file, then serves MCP over stdio. → configure_app_logging("mcp"), serve_mcp()

Selects the private settings file: --config PATH, then the CONFLUENCE_CONFIG variable, then confluence_config.json at the repository root. Settings are validated once and cached per process. → config.load_config
Offline: configured instance, whether a token is stored, and its account name. → AppContext.auth_status
Current and archived spaces. → SpaceService.list_spaces
Literal search with structured scope and cursors. → ContentSearch.search_content
Display-name search, or an exact username. → UserSearch.find_users
Ordered children from a page or space root. → PageTree.get_page_tree
History, versions, labels, contributors and ancestors. → PageMetadataService.get_page_metadata
Budgeted text or unchanged storage, with version-pinned cursors. → PageTextService.get_pages
Read the signed-in account's eight email notification settings. → EmailNotificationSettingsService.get_settings
Update selected email settings for the signed-in account. → EmailNotificationSettingsService.update_settings
Saves selected attachments of one page locally. LOCAL_FILE annotation. → AttachmentDownloads.download_attachments
Full pages as one file or a flat ZIP. LOCAL_FILE annotation. → PageExports.export_pages
Current page or new-page draft. → PageWrites.create_page
Whole-body replacement with expected_version. → PageWrites.update_page
The user's new-page drafts. → PageWrites.list_drafts
Publishes a new-page draft under the same ID. → PageWrites.publish_draft
Permanent; bypasses the trash. → PageWrites.delete_draft
Adds and removes global labels, one request each. → PageWrites.set_labels
Parent, space-root or sibling placement. → PageStructure.move_page
Trash with refuse, move_up or trash for children. → PageStructure.delete_page
Visible trashed pages, one space or all. → PageStructure.list_trash
Restore, then caller, saved or space-root placement. → PageStructure.restore_page
Read one footer or inline comment and its current version. → CommentManagement.get_comment
Create a footer comment or reply; inline creation requires a selected text anchor. → CommentManagement.add_comment
Update a comment at an expected version. → CommentManagement.update_comment
Permanently delete a comment after explicit confirmation. → CommentManagement.delete_comment

Reads the stored username for each call and returns the services bound to it, building them again when the username changes. One lazy httpx.AsyncClient serves the whole process and is closed with aclose().
g.text: • services() → Services(username, api, links, search, tree, pages, writes, comments, email_settings, structure, …), rebuilt when the stored username changes

svg.text: await services() · domain models in, domain models out
service/ · every input is validated here, once

g.title: Builds one literal CQL clause per term for match=all, sends the terms together for any, keeps their order for phrase. Cursors carry the normalized request and the next start + size. → ConfluenceApi.search_content_page
Unscoped title searches add quick-navigation matches on the first page, labelled by source; a failure there leaves CQL results usable. → ConfluenceApi.quicknav_title_matches
Converts UTC bounds to timezone-less CQL minutes in cql_timezone, inclusive, widening repeated daylight-saving hours.
Requests current and archived spaces separately, 500 per request, advancing on the returned start + size. → ConfluenceApi.list_spaces
Display-name search through CQL user search, with cursors. → ConfluenceApi.search_users_page
Former users are found only by exact username. → ConfluenceApi.get_user
One page or a space root; ancestors for a page root. → PageLinkResolver.resolve, ConfluenceApi.list_child_pages / list_space_root_pages
Depth 1 to 5 (default 3) levels below the root, for a page or a space.
Children keep the server's order; a result capped by the page limit says it is incomplete.
Up to 20 references; failures are returned per reference beside the successful pages. → ConfluenceApi.get_page_metadata
Experimental version list, 200 per request, at most 5,000 per page. → ConfluenceApi.list_page_versions
Labels, contributors and ancestors of the current page; versioned references are refused.

Up to 20 pages, packed whole into max_chars; an oversized page is cut between blocks with a version-pinned cursor. Body, attachments and comments are read as three parallel requests. → ConfluenceApi.get_page_content, list_page_attachments, list_page_comments
The unbudgeted read used by exports.
BeautifulSoup pre-pass over the view body (macro, attachment and image markers, typed references), then markdownify, then blocks for the budget.
One page and up to 500 attachment IDs. → ConfluenceApi.list_page_attachments, download_attachment
The page's own attachment list is read first, so an ID from another page is refused.
Collision-safe names in downloads/<account>/; a failed file is removed and listed.
Up to 500 references, validated before any request; pages are read two at a time. → PageTextService.read_full_page, AttachmentDownloads.download_to_directory
Rich exports of up to 20 pages without attachment bytes are direct files; bulk or attachment exports use a ZIP.
Rich comments are separate files; failures have a report; account errors abort the export.
Self-contained, versioned cursors; continuation needs no retained session state.
Account-specific output folders, seven-day cleanup and exclusive file claims.
Measures the effective CQL offset with bounded read-only searches; run by the CLI only.

create_page checks for a duplicate title, converts the body and places the page; update_page refuses a stale expected_version, then sends the next version so a concurrent edit gets 409. → ConfluenceApi.create_page, update_page, position_page
New-page drafts only. delete_draft is permanent. → ConfluenceApi.list_drafts_page, publish_draft, delete_draft
One request per label change, in order, stopping at the first failure; successful changes are reported and never reversed. → ConfluenceApi.add_page_label, remove_page_label
to_storage converts and checks rich input (code macro, expand, void tags; refuses active content); content_loss compares inline-comment anchors, macros and attachment references.
Read one comment with page, author, parent, version and inline metadata. → ConfluenceApi.get_comment
Create footer comments or replies after checking the page and parent ownership. Inline creation needs a text-selection anchor.
Updates require the current version; deletes are permanent and require explicit confirmation.
Optional page references are checked against the comment owner. Each write uses the account-bound transport.
Reads the signed-in account's eight email notification values from the view form. → EmailNotificationSettingsService.get_settings
Merges selected fields into current state, sends the full form and rereads settings. → EmailNotificationSettingsService.update_settings
Uses atl_token through the shared account-bound transport; does not depend on the REST adapter.
Returns mismatches after readback; the configured account received HTTP 403 for writes, an open live check.
Moves pages by parent or position; cross-space moves wait for terminal long-task completion. → ConfluenceApi.move_page_action
Checks delete permission, saves placement, then trashes up to 100 pages according to child policy.
Lists the trash and restores a page to caller, saved or root placement.
Every write stops at its first failure; results separate done, unknown and unattempted steps.

svg.text: remote/ · the only code that knows Confluence routes, JSON and paging

g.title: Page bodies (view, storage), children, versions, attachments and comments, mapped to domain models.
CQL content search, the private quick-navigation title route, and user search.
Documented content create, update, draft publish and delete.
Private movepage.action for parent and position changes; cross-space moves use terminal long-task polling (40 polls, 10 s at most).
Trash, restore, content properties for saved placement, and expand=operations permission checks.

svg.text: labels, attachments, comments and permissions too

g.title: Numeric IDs, /spaces/KEY/pages/ID/…, viewpage.action?pageId=, /x/ short links (followed on the configured origin only) and /display/KEY/Title (looked up by exact title). Other hosts are refused.

HTTP/1.1, six requests in flight per process, bounded read retries; a write is resent only when it was never sent or was answered 429 or 503, otherwise UncertainWrite. The stored account is checked again after every response.
